title: A Reminder About an Appointment
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A voicemail reminding someone to bring a document.

transcript.text: Just a reminder about your appointment at half past ten tomorrow. Bring the form you received by email; you do not need to print it, because showing it on your phone is fine. If you are running late, send a message before you arrive. The appointment should last about half an hour.

questions.explanation: The caller gives the time as half past ten tomorrow.

options: A printed copy of the email
A form that can be shown on a phone
A photograph of the appointment letter
questions.explanation: The caller asks for the emailed form and says a phone copy is acceptable.

questions.prompt: What should the listener do if delayed?
options: Wait until the appointment has ended.
questions.explanation: The caller asks for a message before arrival if the listener is running late.
